title: Remediation / driver record
description: One graded piece of intelligence about WHAT raises or lowers heavy-metal contamination in a food crop, anywhere across the supply chain (soil, water, input, cultivation, processing). Serves HMTc Governing Principle 1 (drive down contamination through reformulation and sourcing improvement). The wiki captures the EVIDENCE, graded; HMTc/courses turn it into recommendations. Soil concentration is never substituted for food concentration: a record about a soil driver describes the driver, not a food number.

record_type.description: driver = a factor that raises/lowers contamination; intervention = a deliberate practice that changes it; regional_observation = a place/time where loads are notably high or low and the putative reason

metal.description: HMTc analyte: Pb, Cd, iAs, tAs, MeHg, tHg, Ni, Al, Cr-VI, Sn (or Cr, U where the source uses them)

supply_chain_stage.description: where in the chain the driver/intervention acts

region.description: country/region the evidence is from, or null

parent_geology.description: volcanic / alluvial / serpentine / mining-affected / etc., or null

factor.description: for drivers: the factor, e.g. soil pH, paddy redox/flooding, phosphate fertilizer, root microbiome, cultivar genotype

direction.description: for drivers: effect of the factor on contamination

intervention.description: for interventions: the practice, e.g. alternate wetting and drying, liming, wollastonite amendment, EPS-producing bacteria inoculation, cultivar selection, vinegar wash

effect_magnitude.description: quantified effect if reported, e.g. '-40% grain iAs', '2.3x lower', 'from 0.8 to 0.3 mg/kg'; null if only directional

comparator.description: what the effect is measured against (control / baseline practice)

evidence_tier.description: A = replicated field trials, systematic reviews, or official codes of practice (Codex/EFSA); B = single field study or strong controlled pot study; C = observational correlation, single mechanism study, or an emergent lead. Grade conservatively.

study_design.description: replicated field trial / pot experiment / observational survey / review / code of practice / mechanism study

confounders.description: what could confound this finding (required for B and C). For a regional low-load observation, name the alternative explanations (geology, rainfall, sampling).

what_would_confirm.description: the controlled comparison that would promote a C-tier lead to actionable evidence (required for C). This is how a lead stays intel instead of being discarded.

transferability.description: could this driver/intervention plausibly transfer to other crops, metals, or regions? The cross-domain optionality value.

summary.description: one-sentence plain statement of the finding

quote.description: supporting text or paraphrase from the source (provenance)

extracted_at.description: ISO date the record was extracted
